name: @hopin/hugo-styleguide
description: This repo contains a theme and content to generate a styleguide for hugo themes

scripts.build-example: rm -rf test/example-site/themes/styleguide test/example-site/content test/example-site/public && mkdir -p test/example-site/themes/styleguide && cp -r assets layouts static theme.toml test/example-site/themes/styleguide/ && rsync -a --exclude .git content/ test/example-site/content/ && cd test/example-site && hugo --environment development
